title: Higher-Order Multifractional Stable Motion: Definition and Fundamental Properties
summary: This paper introduces the $n$-th order multifractional stable motion ($n$-MFSM), a novel stochastic process that simultaneously unifies three key modelling features: heavy-tailed distributions ($α$-stable with $α\in(1,2]$), time-varying local regularity via a functional Hurst parameter $H(t)\in(n-1,n)$, and extended scaling behaviour of order $n\geq1$. No existing framework combines all three.
